column1: # Nifty 50 sector weights — benchmark for Brinson-Fachler attribution (Phase 12b).
# Manual quarterly refresh from the NSE Nifty 50 factsheet. Staleness > 120 days
# from asOf raises a LOW_CONFIDENCE warning in AttributionService.
# Sector labels must match the gazetteer sectors that FactorProperties.indexForSector
# maps to an NSE sector index; sectors without an index (e.g. "Others") are excluded
# from attribution and reported as a benchmark-coverage note.
